name: postman-api-tests
description: Postman API test collection for Restful Booker, run with Newman in GitHub Actions

scripts.test: newman run collections/restful-booker.postman_collection.json -e environments/restful-booker.postman_environment.json -r cli,htmlextra,junit --reporter-htmlextra-export reports/report.html --reporter-htmlextra-title "Restful Booker API Tests" --reporter-junit-export reports/junit.xml

author: Davit Jikurashvili
